name: APOXENOSI
source:
Silas hasn't left her room in a long time.

She says she's fine. She says it doesn't matter.

A voice in the dark disagrees, and it promises to help.

All it takes is one errand, one step through the door, and a world full of eyes that never look away.

[From [url=https://alicejo.itch.io/apoxenosi]itch.io[/url]]
